agree.reason: The safety record, the adult-trainee parallel and the concrete 90-day plan give this skeptical reader a reason to make a phone call, but leading with the two gaps in the first paragraph risks an early screen-out before she reaches the evidence.

honest.reason: Every figure matches the brief, 'seven years' since 2019 is correct for 2026, and the letter rightly drops the unsupported 'cut training time in half' promise in favour of a target set after measuring.

works_the_facts.reason: Facts are restated rather than worked: the 41-to-58 rise is never framed as a 17-point or roughly 40% relative gain, and the new-teacher training is never totalled (about 24 hours a year, roughly 18 trainees over nine years).

right_comparison.reason: The letter doesn't compare itself to the real alternative (a candidate who already knows GMP but can't show teaching outcomes), and it doesn't describe the plant's current onboarding beyond promising to measure it.

qualification.reason: The hedge has checkable dates (60 and 90 days), a measurable sign-off time and a stated consequence if the target is missed, though that consequence is only 'report why' and the target number itself is left open.

objections.reason: It meets the main objection (no regulated-industry or GMP experience) directly with a timeline, but it doesn't say how the GMP learning will happen and doesn't use the documented safety program as evidence of record-keeping discipline.

fit.reason: It is a properly formatted one-page cover letter of suitable length and tone.
